name: TokenVector.UI
description: Thư viện UI đa nền tảng 100% TokenVector (.tkv) - zero dependency: rasterizer, font bitmap, effects, layout flex/grid, 15 widget, cửa sổ native Win32.

modules.name: TkvUI.Core
modules.summary: ColorRgba/ColorHsla, Point2D, Rect2D, Matrix3x2, PixelSurface (list[i64]), Theme, Insets/CornerRadius, DPI, SurfacePool-lite

modules.name: TkvUI.Graphics
modules.summary: draw_line (Bresenham), fill/stroke_round_rect, draw_arc (Sin/Cos), draw_polyline, clip_rect_intersect, draw_image

modules.name: TkvUI.Text
modules.summary: Font bitmap 5x7 (95 glyph + box fallback), glyph atlas pre-baked (text_atlas_draw_string), char_code, measure_string, draw_string (align/tracking/scale), wrap + ellipsis

modules.name: TkvUI.Effects
modules.summary: box_blur, kawase_blur 3-pass, backdrop_blur (glass), specular highlight, drop shadow

modules.name: TkvUI.Platform
modules.summary: detect_platform() thật (probe runtime), Win32 ULW thật, X11/Cocoa stub, Android/iOS host-driven contract

modules.name: TkvUI.Input
modules.summary: hit_test_tree topmost-first, EventDispatcher (pointer capture), TouchEventArgs, GestureRecognizer (tap/pan/pinch)

modules.name: TkvUI.Layout
modules.summary: FlexStyle/GridStyle/Constraint, flex row/col wrap + cross-align + justify, stack, grid + span, DPI, validator

modules.name: TkvUI.Widgets
modules.summary: UIElement + 15 widget, Spring/Tween, InvalidationManager, FrameScheduler, RenderLoop

platforms.android: host-driven contract: set_jni_env + set_frame_buffer + set_dst_bits, cần shim JNI
platforms.ios: host-driven contract: set_frame_buffer, upload RGBA do host (Swift/ObjC) đảm nhiệm

constraints: docs/TkvUI.Roadmap.md §0 - ràng buộc compiler bắt buộc khi viết .tkv (không bitwise, không bool, record không chứa list, import resolve theo thư mục file nguồn...)
